title: Kafka west scale-up: refuse the leader
description: CanResizeVm refuses the current controller-leader (would disrupt the write window) and allows followers.

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: the leader is identified; scale-up of a follower is allowed, the leader refused

whatProves: scale-up honors the leader-safety guard via CanResizeVm.
